name: Don't Wake The Rainbow Friends
desc:
Shhhh... Don't wake the Sleepy Rainbow Friends! 🌈

How to Play : 
- Sneak around and steal Rainbow Friends while they sleep! 😴
- Escape back to your plot when you wake the Rainbow Friends up! 🏃‍♂️
- Survive and collect as many Rainbow Friends as possible! ⚡

👍 Like and Favorite the game for more updates ⭐️

Credits:
- Roy & Charcle - Creators of Rainbow Friends
